# Code Review Instructions

When reviewing code, ensure the following:

1. Code follows project style and naming conventions.
2. All new code is covered by tests, or a reason is given for missing tests.
3. No sensitive data or credentials are present in the codebase.
4. Code is well-documented and easy to understand.
5. All dependencies are necessary and up to date.
6. Pull requests include a clear description of changes and reasoning.
7. Commit messages follow the required format (see commit message instructions).

## Review Checklist
- [ ] Code compiles and passes all tests
- [ ] No obvious bugs or security issues
- [ ] Follows SOLID and DRY principles
- [ ] Documentation is updated if needed
